item.tib: thang lha'i ka bstod ngo mtshar 'bum ldan
item.coloph: ces rgyal gnyan chen thang lha'i ka bstod ngo mtshar 'bum ldan bya ba 'di yang / srung ma mnyes shing th+ya dam skong ba'i ched du/ ldong rigs dka' thub pa 7drang srong g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ tshe dbang bde chen snying pos thos shar du sug bris bgyis pa'i dge des log lta ru tra rtsad nas chod pa'i rgyur gyur cig//
